description: Evidence-traced AI agent for SME site selection in Vietnam — MCP-first on the Geoapify MCP server.
name: sitescout-agent

scripts.demo:dry-run: node web/build.mjs && cd web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .dist
scripts.demo:migrate: wrangler d1 execute sitescout-demo --remote -c web/wrangler.toml --file web/worker/schema.sql
scripts.demo:totals: wrangler d1 execute sitescout-demo --remote -c web/wrangler.toml --command "SELECT d.day, t.credits, t.tiles, s.hits, s.tile_hits, ROUND(s.saved, 2) AS saved FROM (SELECT day FROM totals UNION SELECT day FROM cache_stats) d LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.day = d.day LEFT JOIN cache_stats s ON s.day = d.day WHERE d.day BETWEEN '2026-10-22' AND '2026-11-04' ORDER BY d.day"
